observer_monotonic_domain: Same N305 Python time.monotonic as recorded run; no wall-clock alignment used
assumptions: Same board and observer boots and no monotonic clock discontinuity
Clock-rate differences over the interval small relative to the >4-second margin
The already observed valid last_update was not subsequently reset or corrupted; such reset would be a separate invalidation, not subscription age expiration
limits: This compares the last known valid timestamp, not the unrecorded variable read return code or internal age at anomaly.
